findings.description: Using `or` discards an explicit cause when that exception is falsey. Select `__cause__` by checking whether it is `None` instead.
findings.rationale: If a user raises `TryAgain` from an exception whose class defines `__bool__` to return false (or `__len__` to return zero), this expression falls back to `__context__`. With no context, retry exhaustion still raises the opaque `TryAgain`; with a different context, it raises the wrong exception instead of the explicit cause.
